as_told.title: Betty and Barney Hill abduction came days after an Outer Limits episode

plain: Jesse Michels says that the alien abduction reported by Betty and Barney Hill, a couple who said they were taken aboard a craft, came about 11 days after the first episode of the CBS science fiction series The Outer Limits aired. He draws it from American Cosmic, a book by the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, which he recommends to guests on two shows, and he raises it because the timing would suggest that what was on television and what people report seeing may shape each other.
